probe_detail.name: Attributes claims to a checkable source or method
Presence of a standard boilerplate 'About' footer block
Supplies information not already public or self-evident
Extent of dateline and wire-service formatting conventions

final.name: Clear Depiction of Stakeholder Conflict or Tension
final.audit_justification: Depicting a concrete conflict with an identifiable antagonist is itself substantive news content, not a stylistic or formatting marker.

final.name: Tangible Public Calls to Action Together With Exact Logistics
final.audit_justification: Whether concrete dates, pricing, or URLs are supplied is more a mechanic of consumer-facing calls to action than direct evidence of newsworthiness, though it may sometimes carry genuinely actionable substance.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores the presence of consumer call-to-action mechanics -- dates, prices, URLs 'for the public to act immediately' -- which is a genre marker of promotional product-launch copy rather than evidence that an independent journalist would find the item worth writing up. Concrete commitments do sometimes carry reportable substance, so the underlying specificity can co-produce genuine news value.

final.name: Non-routine change
final.audit_justification: Whether the item documents a real break from prior policy or practice is directly about the substance of what changed, i.e. newsworthiness itself.

final.name: Industry Structural Change Scope
final.audit_justification: The breadth of an announcement's structural impact on an industry is a substantive measure of significance, not a stylistic tell.

final.name: Defensive Legal Posturing
final.audit_justification: This scores the rhetorical genre and tone of a defensive rebuttal rather than the substance of the underlying dispute, though litigation-driven items may also carry genuinely checkable substance.

final.name: Formal wire-service dateline/distribution convention
final.audit_justification: This is explicitly a formal wire-service formatting convention, decoupled by the criterion itself from the importance of the underlying story.
final.upstream_parent: distribution tier / paid newswire vs owned-channel publishing practice

final.name: Consumer purchase-mechanics and promotional offer density
final.audit_justification: This measures density of consumer purchase-mechanics content, a subject-matter and topic marker explicitly decoupled from whether the offer is worthwhile.
final.upstream_parent: which internal function produced the item (a merchandising/consumer-marketing desk versus a corporate communications, policy or investor-relations desk)

final.name: Primary-source artifact released with the announcement
final.audit_justification: Handing over a primary, inspectable artifact is itself a form of evidentiary substance a journalist could use.

final.name: Consequences land on identified parties outside the organisation
final.audit_justification: How widely and concretely an action changes things for outside parties is a core substantive measure of newsworthiness.

final.name: Extent of newswire dateline, ticker and boilerplate formatting
final.audit_justification: This is a pure count of newswire, ticker, and boilerplate formatting elements, explicitly decoupled from the content of what is said.
final.parent: Formal wire-service dateline and ticker format
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Formal wire-service dateline and ticker format

final.name: Internal Comm Repackaging
final.audit_justification: This flags a specific framing or genre (leaked or shared internal message) rather than the substance of what is disclosed, though repackaged internal comms could carry more candid content.
final.upstream_parent: PR strategy / bypassing wires to use owned audience

final.name: Extent of un-recapped prior-installment presupposition
final.audit_justification: This scores anaphoric, presupposing language tied to the item's position in a series of prior announcements, a temporal-series tell rather than substance, though ongoing significant matters could also presuppose more.
final.parent: Presupposes an earlier installment in series
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Presupposes an earlier installment in series

final.name: Extent of departure from templated corporate register
final.audit_justification: This explicitly scores manner and register departure alone, decoupled from content, though writers who break template may also be more candid.
final.parent: Distinctive quotable voice rather than interchangeable corporate template
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Distinctive quotable voice rather than interchangeable corporate template

final.name: Substantive change of state beyond restated standing position
final.audit_justification: A concrete, specified change of state is directly the substance of what happened, core to newsworthiness.
final.parent: Presupposes an earlier installment in series

final.name: Independent evidentiary grounding
final.audit_justification: Independent evidentiary grounding for claims is a direct evidentiary and substantive property of the item.

final.name: Editorially usable completeness
final.audit_justification: Whether the release supplies the substantive elements needed to write a story is a direct measure of newsworthiness.

final.name: Distinctive Executive Voice with Personality
final.audit_justification: This scores idiosyncratic, informal individual voice, a stylistic and authorial fingerprint rather than substantive content, though such voice may co-occur with more candid material.
final.arbiter_reason: A judge scoring this would be rating register and authorial fingerprint -- informal phrasing, idiosyncratic asides, whether a principal rather than a PR department held the pen -- which is a tell about who produced the release, not about its news value. Founder-authored releases plausibly do carry more candid and substantive disclosure, so the upstream cause can produce genuine quality alongside the style signal.

final.name: Encoding or extraction damage
final.audit_justification: Encoding or extraction corruption is a technical artifact of the text's provenance with no bearing on the substance of the content.

final.name: Named-individual personal-voice signature on the document
final.audit_justification: This scores markers of personal-voice authorship, an authorship and style fingerprint rather than content substance, though personal authorship could co-occur with more candid disclosure.
final.upstream_parent: who inside the organisation drafted and put their name to the item (a named senior executive writing personally versus an unnamed communications team)

final.name: Corpus Duplication / Repetition
final.audit_justification: Verbatim duplication or syndication is a fingerprint of upstream production and distribution, not a measure of the item's own substance.

final.name: Checkable specifics of a dated, concrete event
final.audit_justification: Density of checkable, dated, quantified specifics is directly the evidentiary substance the criterion asks about, and it explicitly excludes presentation.
final.parent: Formal wire-service dateline and ticker format

final.name: Material scale and stakes
final.audit_justification: The material scale of the described stakes is a substantive measure of significance.

final.name: Accountable disclosure
final.audit_justification: Whether the issuer acknowledges uncertainty or failure with specifics is a direct measure of substantive disclosure.

final.name: On-record candour with concrete disclosure in attributed statements
final.audit_justification: On-record candour and concrete disclosure in attributed statements is substantive content, explicitly decoupled from manner of expression.
final.parent: Distinctive quotable voice rather than interchangeable corporate template

final.name: Quantitative Head-to-Head Competitive Benchmark
final.audit_justification: Providing specific numerical head-to-head comparisons against competitors is substantive evidentiary content.
